falsifier.interpretation: Provider effective rules do not encode PR-only convergence. Merge queue is present, but GitHub models require-pull-request as a separate branch rule.

acceptance: Add an active pull_request rule covering refs/heads/main.
Choose review/code-owner requirements according to repository policy rather than inferring them from merge queue.
Read back effective provider rules and fail repository governance verification if the PR-only rule disappears.
nonClaims: No direct push to main was attempted as part of this falsifier.
This evidence does not claim that every repository writer would intentionally bypass the intended merge queue.
GitHub provider truth is independent from local Git integration truth.
